assumptions.sowing_window_days: CEEW reports a 15-18 day harvest-to-sowing window in Punjab; we use the conservative end.
assumptions.machine_rate_ha_per_day: ASSUMPTION ~8 acres/day per seeder + tractor. Verify before quoting.
assumptions.share_needing_chc: ASSUMPTION: share of rice area that depends on rented (CHC) machines rather than owned machines. Verify or present as a scenario slider.
assumptions.baseline_request_lag_days: ASSUMPTION: reactive booking starts after harvest, with ~2 days of booking/paperwork/dispatch delay.
